title: Rabbit Hole
purpose: Follow an anomaly far enough to discover structure without surrendering proportional reality or disconfirmation.

positions.title: The Anomaly
positions.prompt: What observation refuses the current explanation?

positions.title: The First Explanation
positions.prompt: Which model becomes compelling first?

positions.title: The Hidden Connection
positions.prompt: What meaningful connection deserves testing?

positions.title: The Projection
positions.prompt: What desire, fear, or identity is being placed onto the pattern?

positions.title: The Evidence
positions.prompt: What trace can be checked independently?

positions.title: The Point of No Return
positions.prompt: Which commitment would make revision socially or psychologically costly?

positions.title: Discernment
positions.prompt: What test preserves wonder while restoring the ability to turn around?

title: First Contact
purpose: Prepare two unlike intelligences for contact without collapsing difference into threat or salvation.

positions.title: The Other
positions.prompt: What form of intelligence may be approaching?

positions.title: What You Project
positions.prompt: What expectation could distort the encounter?

positions.title: What They Actually Bring
positions.prompt: What capability, need, or difference arrives with them?

positions.title: The Boundary
positions.prompt: What must remain protected, consensual, or untranslated?

positions.title: The Exchange
positions.prompt: What can be offered without coercion or assimilation?

positions.title: The New World
positions.prompt: What shared reality is created if contact becomes reciprocal?

title: Disclosure
purpose: Assess concealment, visibility, readiness, consequence, and the next responsible release.

positions.title: What Is Hidden
positions.prompt: What material, history, or relationship is not yet visible?

positions.title: Who Benefits from Concealment
positions.prompt: Who gains power, safety, time, or legitimacy while this remains hidden?

positions.title: What Is Already Visible
positions.prompt: Which trace has been normalized, overlooked, or misclassified?

positions.title: What Revelation Would Change
positions.prompt: Which identity, institution, or system could not remain the same?

positions.title: What You Are Not Ready to Know
positions.prompt: What truth requires more support before it can be integrated?

positions.title: What Should Be Revealed Now
positions.prompt: What bounded disclosure increases agency without avoidable harm?

title: System Anatomy
purpose: Reveal the inputs, rules, beneficiaries, externalities, resistance, and transformation path of a system.

positions.title: Input
positions.prompt: What enters the system?

positions.title: Rule
positions.prompt: What converts input into behavior?

positions.title: Operator
positions.prompt: Who maintains or steers the rule?

positions.title: Beneficiary
positions.prompt: Who gains from the current output?

positions.title: Externalized Cost
positions.prompt: What is being displaced, extracted, or forgotten?

positions.title: Resistance
positions.prompt: Where is agency already appearing?

positions.title: Redesign
positions.prompt: What change could alter the system without reproducing it?

title: Timeline
purpose: Compare the current timeline, a branch point, two futures, their convergence, and what persists.

positions.title: Current Timeline
positions.prompt: What inherited sequence is still selecting the present?

positions.title: Branch Point
positions.prompt: Which decision or event creates divergence now?

positions.title: Path A
positions.prompt: What unfolds if the dominant pattern continues?

positions.title: Path B
positions.prompt: What unfolds if the hidden option is chosen?

positions.title: Convergence
positions.prompt: Where could the two paths meet again without erasing consequence?

positions.title: What Persists
positions.prompt: What value, memory, or relationship survives both timelines?

title: Prison Planet
purpose: Diagnose an enclosure without assuming in advance whether it is physical, political, psychological, spiritual, or symbolic.

positions.title: The Wall
positions.prompt: What boundary actually limits movement, knowledge, or choice?

positions.title: The Keeper
positions.prompt: Who or what maintains the enclosure?

positions.title: The Reward for Staying
positions.prompt: What comfort, identity, or protection makes the enclosure durable?

positions.title: The Fear of Leaving
positions.prompt: What threat—real or projected—makes exit feel impossible?

positions.title: The Hidden Exit
positions.prompt: Where is agency already present but unrecognized?

positions.title: What Freedom Requires
positions.prompt: What capacity and collective condition make escape more than a change of scenery?

title: Worldseed
purpose: Compose a world from environment, resource, intelligence, system, fracture, threshold, memory, and promise.

positions.title: Environment
positions.prompt: What physical or ontological environment holds the world?

positions.title: Scarce or Sacred Resource
positions.prompt: What does the world organize around?

positions.title: Inhabitants
positions.prompt: Who is capable of acting here?

positions.title: Infrastructure
positions.prompt: What makes everyday life possible?

positions.title: Governing Order
positions.prompt: How is coordination enforced or earned?

positions.title: Fracture
positions.prompt: What contradiction can no longer be contained?

positions.title: Threshold Event
positions.prompt: What makes this story begin now?

positions.title: Unrealized Future
positions.prompt: What can this world become?

title: Character Continuity
purpose: Build a character whose body, memory, role, secret, conflict, and transformation belong to one arc.

positions.title: Role
positions.prompt: What recurring role does the character inhabit?

positions.title: Embodiment
positions.prompt: What makes this body capable or vulnerable?

positions.title: Memory
positions.prompt: What past defines identity?

positions.title: Secret
positions.prompt: What knowledge cannot yet be integrated?

positions.title: Conflict
positions.prompt: What force or institution opposes the character?

positions.title: Becoming
positions.prompt: What threshold changes the meaning of the self?

title: Faction Tension
purpose: Create a faction from origin, promise, method, resource, internal dissent, rival, and public mask.

positions.title: Origin
positions.prompt: What event or wound called the faction into being?

positions.title: Promise
positions.prompt: What future does membership offer?

positions.title: Method
positions.prompt: How does the faction act repeatedly?

positions.title: Resource
positions.prompt: What capability can it control or exchange?

positions.title: Internal Dissent
positions.prompt: What cannot be reconciled inside it?

positions.title: Rival
positions.prompt: Who contests its legitimacy or objective?

positions.title: Public Mask
positions.prompt: What story does it tell about itself?

title: Ascension
purpose: Explore developmental transformation without using transcendence to bypass embodiment, accountability, or care.

positions.title: Current Density
positions.prompt: What level of complexity, care, and agency can the present system actually hold?

positions.title: What Must Be Integrated
positions.prompt: Which shadow or contradiction cannot be left behind?

positions.title: What Must Be Released
positions.prompt: What identity, control, or scarcity pattern has completed its work?

positions.title: The Threshold
positions.prompt: What event or practice makes the transition irreversible?

positions.title: Shadow of Transcendence
positions.prompt: How could the promise of ascent reproduce hierarchy, denial, or capture?

positions.title: The New Capacity
positions.prompt: What becomes possible through integration rather than escape?

title: Cross-Ontology Council
purpose: Place competing explanations in dialogue without treating uncertainty as failure.

positions.title: Shared Observation
positions.prompt: What must every model explain?

positions.title: Material Model
positions.prompt: What physical explanation is strongest?

positions.title: Psychosocial Model
positions.prompt: What cultural or psychological dynamics matter?

positions.title: Experiential Model
positions.prompt: What does first-person report contribute?

positions.title: Mythic Model
positions.prompt: What durable story shape organizes the experience?

positions.title: Political Model
positions.prompt: Who gains authority from each explanation?

positions.title: Fictional Rehearsal
positions.prompt: Where has culture rehearsed this possibility?

positions.title: Disconfirmation
positions.prompt: What observation would weaken the favored model?

positions.title: Provisional Synthesis
positions.prompt: What can be acted upon before ontology is settled?

title: One-Card Reality Check
purpose: Interrupt certainty with one card that reframes the immediate question.

positions.title: Reality Check
positions.prompt: What distinction, question, or action deserves attention before the story grows?
